note: Both sets share a significant hallucination on the Living Room finished floor height (claiming 2'-3 1/2" instead of the visible 2'-9 1/2"). Set A is preferred because it binds attributes more precisely to their specific sections (e.g., Detail A1 vs C1) and avoids the trivial or vague claims found in Set B (e.g., 'Location | West' or 'Location | K'). Set B is also noisier, containing multiple redundant claims for the same elevations and scales.
